availability.note: Geely AU configurator lists Complete, Inspire Extended Range and Inspire AWD on the research date.

listPrice.note: CarExpert 2027 review price table, before on-road costs; configurator shows $37,490 without basis wording; CarExpert news 19 May 2026 'remains at $37,490 before on-road costs'; zecar 'excl. on-road costs'.

rangeKm.note: WLTP combined; UK Pro/Max on the same 18.4 kWh pack quoted 51 miles (82 km) WLTP, so not an NEDC submission.

combinedRangeKm.note: 83 + 51 L / 6.2 x 100 = 905.6. Tank 51 L per CarExpert spec page; Geely's own WLTP total 943 km (CarExpert news) implies the same 51 L at 5.93 L/100km WLTP charge-sustaining.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: Charge-sustaining figure from real-world reviews: Chasing Cars 5.9-7.0 battery depleted, Auto Express 6.6; Geely's WLTP total range implies 5.93. Kept from held data; matches sibling ordering (jaecoo-j7-shs 5.9, byd-sealion-6 4.8-5.8).

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: CarExpert 2027 review: 428 L seats up. CarExpert spec pages quote 528 L 'to the lower window', which needs the floor panel removed (NRMA); 428 kept as the usable figure.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: 2,065 L seats down; CarExpert review confirms 2,065 L for FWD.

insuranceAnnual.note: Anchored to chery-tiggo-7-phev-urban ($37,990, 1450) and byd-sealion-6-essential ($42,990, 1450); kept from held data.

warrantyYears.note: 84 months / unlimited km whole vehicle, no servicing condition; battery 96 months / unlimited km to 70%. Also stated in CarExpert's 2027 review.

depreciationCurve.note: Brand convention shared with geely-ex5: steeper than the mainstream default for a brand with ~2 years of Australian sales, repeated campaign discounting (6% off plus 0.88% finance EOFY; $500 factory bonus plus 0.68% finance Black Friday on geely.com.au) and no resale record.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green passenger car = combined CO2 <= 120 g/km. WLTP label 2.4 L/100km equates to roughly 56 g/km, far below 120.

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: WLTP combined label 2.4 L/100km, at or below 3.5.

availability.note: New grade, listed on Geely AU configurator at $44,990; in dealers from mid-September 2026 (zecar); reviewed by CarExpert and CarsGuide (13 Oct 2026).

listPrice.note: zecar '$44,990 plus on-road costs' / 'Recommended Retail Price (excl. on-road costs)'; CarsGuide and CarExpert review 'before on-road costs'; configurator $44,990. Lead's basis confirmed as list, not drive-away (CarExpert Sydney drive-away is $49,357).

rangeKm.note: Geely AU WLTP combined claim. The UK did not take the AWD (UK range is Pro/Max/Ultra, all FWD), so no European cross-check exists; 130 km sits below the FWD's 136 km on the same pack, consistent with WLTP. CarExpert achieved 135 km on test.

combinedRangeKm.note: 130 + 60 L / 6.7 x 100 = 1025.5. Tank 60 L (CarExpert spec, CarExpert review, CarsGuide, zecar). Geely's 'up to 1065 km' WLTP total on geely.com.au implies 6.42 L/100km WLTP charge-sustaining.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: FWD's 6.2 scaled by Geely's own WLTP charge-sustaining ratio AWD/FWD (6.42 / 5.93 = 1.083, implied by 1065 km on 60 L vs 996 km on 51 L). Reviewers saw 5.0-5.3 on mountain/descent routes (CarsGuide, CarExpert), not representative. Sibling byd-sealion-6 AWD sits 1.0 above its FWD.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: CarExpert 2027 AWD review: rear motor reduces underfloor space, max 1,993 L vs 2,065 L FWD (CarsGuide: 72 L less underfloor). CarExpert spec page still shows 2,065 L, likely copied from FWD.

towKg.note: 1,050 kg braked, 750 kg unbraked; CarExpert review agrees.
